_comment: Thresholds for the accuracy benchmark. Mirrors docs/accuracy-benchmark.md §5; the doc is the single source of truth. Constants the app itself uses are duplicated in src/features/diagnostics/{output-alpha,raw-mask-stats}.ts and asserted equal by scripts/eval/accuracy-benchmark.py --self-test.

perCategory._comment: Categories whose subjects are legitimately multi-part relax the fragmentation gate (§5.2).

accuracy._comment: §5.3 — Tier-B accuracy floors, applied only where a ground-truth mask exists. Calibrate against the human-label ceiling before using as a hard gate.

timingMs._comment: §5.4 — per-provider latency budget on the warm mean infer_ms. Latency is a pass/fail gate, never a quality ranking.
